items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: And I did quite a bit of recording with Billy May.

ctx.x: I see some more notes of yours. What

have you got written down there? Well, I want to mention the fact that I did work with Neal Hefti quite a bit this past summer. He had a band, he formed another band. He got the yen to conduct again, and that was quite a pleasure. We worked Disney band and quite a few casuals, and Nat Pierce was the pianist. And Frankie Capp was drummer, and it was a very good band, any way. And I did quite a bit of recording with Billy May. Now, the -- here we go again.
